title: Rabbi Elazar ben Zimra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of Bereshit Rabbah chapter 39, his precious saying is cited: “If all the world's inhabitants gathered to create even one gnat, they could not.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read Rabbi Elazar in the name of Rabbi Yose ben Zimra, as in the same work, 84:4.

notes.text: ספל״ט means the end of chapter 39; פפ״ד-ד means chapter 84, section 4. The correction turns an apparent patronymic into a report in Yose ben Zimra’s name.

The consulted Bereshit Rabbah chapter 39 passage has Elazar bar Zimra and continues with the question of imparting a soul. Bereshit Rabbah 84:4 has Elazar reporting in Yose ben Zimra’s name. The proposed correction is Hyman’s.
